scientific_integrity: Proof is a fully specified computational discrete-Morse construction with explicit graph, all simplices and face incidences, a ten-step unique-gradient-path cancellation, and a signed integral zero attaching-degree matrix. Independent mod-two simplicial homology and matching-polynomial computations reproduce the reported ranks. Only self-review was performed.
scientific_limitations: A finite statement for the ordinary matching complex of GP(10,2), not a classification of generalized Petersen graph families. An equivalent unindexed calculation remains possible. The closest public mod-two calculation was identified via an indexed record; its full repository text could not be accessed.
title: The dodecahedral matching complex is a wedge of five 5-spheres and 117 6-spheres
